desc:
Kick the ball onto your rivals ice. 
Every landing cracks it. 
Two cracks and the ice shatters, dropping them into the sea. 
Last one standing wins!

🎮 CONTROLS
PC: Left Click = Kick, E = Slide, R = Power, Space = Jump (change keys in Settings)
Console: RT / R2 = Kick, X / Square = Slide, Y / Triangle = Power, A / Cross = Jump
Mobile: tap the Kick, Slide and Power buttons on screen, plus the jump button

💡 TIPS
Kick in the air for a fast Fly Kick.
Jump again next to a wall to kick off it, then kick for a Bicycle Kick.
Your side may only touch the ball twice in a row!
